The institutional investor held 41,166 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.97 million, up from 21,540 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.31 billion market cap company.
